module_summary: dialogs.cpp holds every static UIItem table of the menu ELF (settings pages, per-game menus, PADEMU, file manager, drive status, About); most settings tables are never executed directly but copied into a RAM page by SettingsShell::compose/composeInto in guisettings.cpp. gui.cpp is the GUI runtime (class Gui with one global instance gGui: frame lock, deferred-op queue drained once a frame, main loop, probe frame) plus one-line C wrappers that the rest of the program calls; gui.h declares the whole guiXxx API spread over the split-off gui*.cpp files. drivestatus.cpp is the RIPPS2-derived Drive Status page (BDM/HDD/MMCE/memory card enumeration with size text and Save Diagnostics). guiboot.cpp is the boot-splash status line with a lock-free sticky label for IO-thread steps; guifilemgr.h only holds the File Manager dialog ids.

reusable_helpers.name: dsSizeText
reusable_helpers.what: formats a KB count as 'N KB' / 'N MB' / 'N.N GB' / 'N.N TB'

reusable_helpers.name: dsDriverLabel
reusable_helpers.what: maps a BDM driver name (usb, sd/ilink, sdc/mx4sio, udp, ata) to a display label

reusable_helpers.name: dsFsName
reusable_helpers.what: maps a BDM FAT/exFAT type code to its name

reusable_helpers.name: Gui::createOp / guiOpCreate
reusable_helpers.what: allocates a zeroed deferred GUI update op of a given type

reusable_helpers.name: BootStatus::setStickyCopy
reusable_helpers.what: lock-free double-buffered string publish from the IO thread to the renderer

findings.title: Composed-only settings tables keep never-shown legacy button rows, plus the skip-ID plumbing that exists only to hide them
findings.problem: diaMmceConfig, diaLaunchConfig and diaVcdConfig are only ever used as parts of SettingsShell::compose/composeInto, and every such call passes the rows' ids in skipIDs, so the MMCE_COMM_BUTTON, MMCE_PATH_BUTTON, LAUNCH_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS_BUTTON and VCD_BDMA_BUTTON rows are never rendered and no code handles them. The comments claiming standalone 'legacy callers/editors' (BDMA, MMCE comm/path, Security password, Advanced) are false: those tables are only composed, and their UI_HEADER rows are dropped by suppressSecondaryHeaders=1 in every multi-part compose call.
findings.fix: Delete the four LABEL/SPACER/BUTTON/BREAK groups and their enum values; then delete the skipIDs arrays, guiSettingsSkipID, the orphan-label/skip block in composeInto and the skipIDs/skipCount/skipPart parameters (skipPart is -1 at every call). Delete or correct the stale 'legacy caller' comments, and make guiBdmaUpdater use activeDialog() without the diaBdmaConfig fallback.
findings.benefit: ~55 source lines removed (18 table/comment lines in dialogs.cpp, 4 enum lines, ~30 in guisettings.cpp); a few UIItem rows of .data (INFERRED, not measured)
findings.evidence: Grep VCD_BDMA_BUTTON|VCD_LIST_BUTTON|VCD_NET_BUTTON|MMCE_COMM_BUTTON|MMCE_PATH_BUTTON|LAUNCH_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS_BUTTON over src/RiptOPL (*.cpp,*.c,*.h,*.py,*.sh): MMCE_COMM/PATH, LAUNCH_NEUTRINO_DEFAULTS and VCD_BDMA appear only in dialogs.h enum, dialogs.cpp rows and guisettings.cpp skipIDs (360, 2799, 2904); VCD_LIST/NET are handled (2946, 2950) and stay. Grep of the table names: diaMmceConfig/Comm/Path only at guisettings.cpp:359, diaLaunchConfig/diaNeutrinoDefaults only at 2798, diaVcdConfig/diaBdmaConfig only at 2903 plus the updater fallback at 1103, diaSecurityConfig/diaAdvancedConfig only at 2358. All compose calls (377, 2359, 2421, 2478, 2617, 2803, 2911) pass skipPart -1; multi-part ones pass suppressSecondaryHeaders 1, which drops part>0 headers (2100-2105). guiShowBdmaConfig named in a comment at 2899 does not exist.

findings.title: gui.cpp and three split-off files carry the same ~25 unused #include lines with comments naming code that is not in them
findings.problem: The include block of the pre-split gui.cpp was copied verbatim into guiwait.cpp, guimodal.cpp and guigameid.cpp. In gui.cpp none of the symbols the comments name (httpTestServer, bdmIsUDPBDLoaded, tarInvalidate, appGetObject, libViewActive, gFAVStartMode, gLastDeferredTimedOut, sfxGetPlayDiag) are used, nor anything from mmce/eth/net/udpfs/http/artindex/bdm/hdd/vcd/libview/pggsm/cheatman/guigame/appsupport/tar headers, <limits.h>, <math.h> or <time.h>; sound.h is included twice. The same comment-tagged headers are unused in the three copies.
findings.fix: Delete the unused includes (and the duplicate sound.h) from gui.cpp, guiwait.cpp, guimodal.cpp and guigameid.cpp, keeping only headers whose symbols each file uses; let the compiler confirm.
findings.benefit: ~80 include lines removed across 4 files (gui.cpp ~23 verified, ~19 per copy INFERRED); faster rebuilds, no ELF change
findings.evidence: Grep over src/ui/gui.cpp for bdm|http|tar[A-Z]|appGet|libView|gFAV|gLastDeferred|io[A-Z]|mmce|eth[A-Z]|udpfs|artIndex|hdd|vcd|gsm|cheat|guiGame|time(|sfxGet|INT_MAX|sqrt: only the #include lines match. Symbols gui.cpp does use (showNetDhcpPopup, DisableCron, KeyPressedOnce, gOPLPart, gEnableBGM) are declared in opl.h:462,509,507,531,442; bgmStart in sound.h:30; cacheTickArt texcache.h:156; guiDrawOverlays/guiDrawBusy guiint.h:12,16. Grep http|tarInv|appGet|bdm[A-Z]|vcd[A-Z]|libView|gFAV|cheat|mmce|udpfs over guiwait/guimodal/guigameid: only include lines (guimodal uses cheatConfig*, not cheatman). Unused status of the non-commented headers in the three copies is INFERRED.

findings.title: Drive enumeration and size formatting are implemented twice (Drive Status vs File Manager)
findings.problem: fmScanDrives repeats dsScan's BDM loop (fileXioDopen, bdmReadDriverName, dsDriverLabel, exFAT-HDD fallback), the mmce0/1 opendir probe, the mcGetInfo+mcSync loop with _STR_DRIVE_STATUS_MC and the hddGetSpace/dsSizeText HDD line; about 25 lines are the same logic. fmSizeText is dsSizeText with a bytes-to-KB rounding and a decimal MB branch.
findings.fix: Have fmSizeText round bytes to KB and call dsSizeText (accepting one MB format), and move the shared probes into one drive walker used by both pages, each keeping only its own line formatting.
findings.justification: Same logic in two files; one walker plus a callback or flag removes more lines than it adds and keeps the two drive lists from drifting apart (they already differ on the mc free-cluster check).
findings.benefit: ~20 lines net removed (INFERRED: ~25 duplicated scan lines and 9 formatter lines, minus a ~12-line shared walker); no measurable ELF change
findings.evidence: Read drivestatus.cpp:35-151 and guifilemgr.cpp:150-219, filemgr.cpp:627-636. Grep fmSizeText|dsSizeText: definitions at filemgr.cpp:627 and drivestatus.cpp:35; guifilemgr.cpp already calls dsSizeText/dsDriverLabel (190, 211-212). Host tests .github/scripts/test_ripps2_drive_status.py and test_file_manager.py exercise both formatters and would need their expected strings checked.

findings.title: GUI_OP_ADD_HINT deferred op is never queued: dead enum, union member and handler case
findings.problem: No code creates a GUI_OP_ADD_HINT op: the name appears only in the enum and the handleOp case, and the union's hint member is read only by that case. Hints are added directly under menuHintsLock in opl.cpp:366-404 and themeelems.cpp:2280-2323.
findings.fix: Delete GUI_OP_ADD_HINT, the hint struct in gui_update_t and the case in Gui::handleOp.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed; a few bytes of .text (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep -w GUI_OP_ADD_HINT over src/RiptOPL *.cpp/*.c/*.h: gui.h:18 and gui.cpp:281 only. Grep '->hint\.|\.hint\.': gui.cpp:284 only. menuAddHint other callers: opl.cpp:371-400; menuHintsLock also used at menusys.cpp:1438, themeelems.cpp:2280, so those stay.

findings.title: class Gui has one instance and is used only through one-line C wrappers: two layers for one API
findings.problem: Every public Gui method is reached through a guiXxx forwarder in gui.cpp:477-498; outside gui.cpp the class is touched once (guisplash.cpp:229, gGui.runFrameHook). handleOpThunk exists only to turn the member back into a plain function for the queue, mainLoop repeats runFrameHook inline, and queueSema_ is a member though only init() needs it.
findings.fix: Make the Gui members file-static state in gui.cpp and turn the methods into the guiXxx functions themselves; delete guiruntime.h, the forwarders and handleOpThunk. Smaller step: at least call runFrameHook in mainLoop and make queueSema_ a local in init().
findings.benefit: ~60 lines removed (INFERRED: 72-line guiruntime.h and 22 forwarders replaced by ~15 lines of static state); no ELF change expected
findings.evidence: Read gui.cpp in full and include/guiruntime.h. Grep 'gGui\.|Gui::' over src and include: 45 hits in gui.cpp, guisplash.cpp:229 (runFrameHook), and fntsys.cpp:130 which is only a comment naming Gui::updateScreenScale.

findings.title: Two label ids that nothing addresses: CFG_LBL_POPSTARTER_PATH and CFG_LBL_VCD_USB_BDMA
findings.problem: Both ids are given to static labels but no diaSet*/diaGet* call or other code uses them; the label rows would behave the same with id 0, like the other plain labels.
findings.fix: Set both label ids to 0 and delete the two enum values.
findings.evidence: Grep -w CFG_LBL_VCD_USB_BDMA|CFG_LBL_POPSTARTER_PATH over src/RiptOPL *.cpp/*.c/*.h: dialogs.h:113,127 and dialogs.cpp:619,701 only.

findings.title: BootStatus::active_ duplicates text_[0] != 0; guiboot.h names a wrong source path
findings.problem: set(NULL) clears both text_ and active_, set(s) sets both, and line() requires active_ AND text_[0] != 0, so active_ never changes the result. The header points at src/guiboot.cpp; the file is src/ui/guiboot.cpp.
findings.fix: Delete active_ and test text_[0] alone; fix the path in the comment.
findings.evidence: Read guiboot.h and guiboot.cpp in full; active_ is only written at guiboot.cpp:18,23 and read at :50.

findings.title: Stale comments and markers in dialogs.cpp and gui.h describing code that is gone
findings.problem: dialogs.cpp:2263-2268 is a six-line note about a removed row (gEnableAnalogNav, which no longer exists anywhere); 944-947 and 1067-1069 narrate the removed diaDisplayConfig. All 29 UIString stores at 14-42 carry __attribute__((unused)) although each is referenced by a DIA_STRING row. gui.h:239 says guiShowRANotices() is called each frame; no such function exists (the notice is drawn by gNotifications.drawRA in gui.cpp:360).
findings.fix: Delete the history comments and the 29 unused attributes; correct the gui.h comment to name drawRA.
findings.benefit: ~12 comment lines removed and 29 lines shortened; no ELF change
findings.evidence: Grep diaDisplayConfig|gEnableAnalogNav|guiShowRANotices over *.cpp/*.c/*.h: only these comment lines. Each diaStr_* name at dialogs.cpp:14-42 appears in a DIA_STRING(...) row (151, 169, 174, 179, 186, 217, 426, 431, 436, 468, 478, 621, 934, 1257, 1308, 1333, 1337, 1392, 1399, 1404, 1513, 2230, 2338-2368), none under #if.
